snippet.title: Gate Guard Simulator - Play the Demo on Steam!
snippet.description:
Play the Demo on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4111570/Gate_Guard_Simulator/

Step into the boots of the castle guard. Inspect seals, expose smugglers, and reveal witches. You decide who enters and who’s turned away. Will you uphold the law, or break it for your own gain?

Join our official discord for more news!
http://discord.com/invite/YjTbXnTpct
